briefdescription.para: Supported default legend symbols.

detaileddescription.para: Line draws the series line style and marker, Fill a filled swatch, and Marker only the series marker shape (used by unconnected series such as PointCloud).

Marker shapes shared by every series that draws markers.

detaileddescription.para: Every shape except Pixel fits within a square whose half-width is the marker size. The shaders select a shape by this value minus one, so append new shapes at the end and never reorder or insert. Series that always draw markers, such as PointCloud, do not accept None.

Updates the series geometry to exactly cover rect.
Replaces the series data with count records copied from an interleaved double array. Each concrete series defines its record layout (XY pairs or rectangle edges).

Replaces the series data by moving an interleaved float buffer.

detaileddescription.para: The first read after a data update scans the records, unless the update came with DataBounds.

briefdescription.para: Returns the extent this series reports to its vertical axis, or std::nullopt when it has none.
Emitted when the dataRevision property changes.
Advances the data revision and refreshes the data queries. Call after every accepted record change.
Refreshes the data queries after record validity changed without a data change, such as an axis scale switch.
Returns a view of the XY records that sample queries search. The default has none.
Returns false while the records are ambiguous, such as during a data transition. Default: true.
Returns the native record at index for series that are not plain XY series. Default: unsupported.
Returns the native record drawn at the series-local position. Default: unsupported.
Scans the records for their extents. The default implementation has none.

detaileddescription.para: Called when a data range is read after invalidateDataRanges(), so a series that nothing asks for its range never scans.

briefdescription.para: Discards the cached extents and notifies the bound axes.

detaileddescription.para: Call after every change of the records, or of anything else computeDataRanges() depends on.

briefdescription.para: Widens the X extent to include x and notifies the bound axes.

detaileddescription.para: Lets an append-style ingestion path keep computed extents current in O(1) instead of rescanning the whole buffer. A non-finite x leaves the extent unchanged.

briefdescription.para: Widens the Y extent to include y. A non-finite y leaves the extent unchanged.
Called when a bound axis switches between linear and logarithmic scale, or a different axis is bound.

detaileddescription.para: Log scale changes which samples are valid, so series that apply the invalid-sample contract override this to refresh ranges and cached geometry. The default implementation does nothing.

briefdescription.para: Called when the viewport of a bound axis changes. The default implementation schedules a repaint.
Returns the plot area to render into: plotRect when set, otherwise the item's current size.

detaileddescription.para: Safe to call from updatePaintNode(); it never modifies the item.

briefdescription.para: Withholds hover events from a series beneath another series under the cursor.

detaileddescription.para: Series ignore hover events so that the plot receives them too. Qt Quick 6.3 and newer stop at the topmost hovered item anyway; older versions also deliver the event to the series beneath, which then see a hover leave instead.

briefdescription.para: Common QML item contract for data series hosted by PlotView.

detaileddescription.para: PlotSeries owns the integration shared by every plot type: axis bindings, plot-area layout, data-range reporting, legend metadata, and a common C++ data-setting API. Concrete series define their record layout, rendering, and hit testing.
